name: Dunderdale Recreation Ground Play Area
description: A play area refurbished in the council's Big Parks and Play Area Project, with toddler and junior multi-play units, springers, swings, a climbing frame, a balance board, a roundabout and a seesaw, with a 1.5m wide wheelchair-friendly path (completed January 2025).
